activity.notes: Representative year for the opening of the Suez Canal in 1869, marking de Lesseps's central role in organizing and promoting the canal enterprise after the 1854 concession.

sources.title: Suez Canal History — Suez Canal Authority
sources.citation_text: The Suez Canal Authority records the 1854 concession to Ferdinand de Lesseps, the canal company and works, and the canal's inauguration in 1869.
